tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skyabs 'gro'i khrid yig mdor bsdus dang gtor ma'i rim pa gsal ba bzhugs/

spangs rtogs mthar phyin rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug dam pa'i chos/ /tshogs gnyis nyams len dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir skyabs 'gro byed tshul gyi rim pa nyams len du 'khyer bde bar 'god pa la bzhi/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i dgos pa/ phan yon/ 'gro tshul/ bslab bya'o/ /dang po ni/ dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro dgos te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal ma mjal dang*/ bstan pa la zhugs ma zhugs ni dkon mchog la skyabs su song ma song ba'i sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir te/ dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba'i skyabs 'gro ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'jug pa'i sgo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa/ skyabs su song ba'i phan yon yod de/ nang pa sangs rgyas par chud pa sdom pa thams cad skye ba'i rten byed pa/ sdig ltung 'dag pa/ tshogs rdzogs pa/ ngan song las thar ba/ myur du 'tshang rgya ba sogs kyi phan yon yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa/ skyabs su 'gro tshul la/ bsam pa ni 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas de las skyob pa'i nus pa dkon mchog la yod par yid ches te/ khyed mkhyen snyam du snying thag pa nas re ltos 'cha' ba'i blos skyabs su 'gro dgos so/ /gzhan du na bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o zhes sogs kyi tshig tsam mang du brjod pa las phan yon tsam 'byung yang*/ dkon mchog la skyabs su song ba'i skyabs 'gro mtshan nyid par 'gyur ba ma yin te/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can dngos ni rjod pa'i tshig tsam ma yin par/ dkon mchog la dpung gnyen du re ltos 'cha' ba'i blo zhig gi steng na 'jog dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul ni/ spyir phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i dkon mchog gsum dmigs yul du byed pa'am/ tshogs zhing du spyan drangs nas yan lag bdun pa phul te/ skyabs su 'gro ba'ang rung mod/ 'jug pa bde ched 'di ltar bya bar gsungs te/

de yang*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i rgyal ba shākya thub pa la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor nas 'khrigs se bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod dam ma yin kyang de'i mos pa shugs can bya/ de nas rang dang sems can thams cad mnyam du/ phyogs bcu nas/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sogs skyabs 'gro bzhi skor gang mang dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor sogs btags pa'i skyabs 'gro drug skor/ lan bdun nam gsum sogs bya zhing de'i tshe/ skyabs gnas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od dkar po dpag tu med pa byung nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag par gyur song snyam du bsam/ de nas yang*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ / khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum sogs brjod pas/ skyabs yul rnams dgyes bzhin 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par byas so/ /snyam du bsam mo/ /bzhi pa/ bslab bya bsdu na/ bris 'bur gyi sku gzugs gang yin kyang sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes/ chos tshigs bcad gcig yan la chos dkon mchog gi 'du shes/ rab byung gi rtags tsam 'dzin pa la'ang dge 'dun dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes 'jog cing*/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas 'jig rten pa'i lha la/ skyabs su mi 'gro/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la gnod tshe spong*/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas grogs dkon mchog la mi gus pa dang mdza' mthun byas nas mi 'grogs shing*/ ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyis mchod pa sogs la bslab dgos so/ /de nas sems bskyed sogs byed na/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam ste/

sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma dang*/ dkon cog gsum la sogs gnyis ka'am gang rung lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba la 'god 'dod kyi byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje dang*/ bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa'i dga' ba dang*/ nye ring chags sdang dang bral 'dod kyi btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o snyam ste bsams pa thag pas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig sogs lan gsum brjod nas tshad med bzhi bsgom mo/ /de ltar tshul bzhin du nyams su blangs nas chos kyi gnad bsdus pa'i sdom nyams su blangs par 'gyur bas don shin tu che la/ tshig tsam gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi byed pa la ni snying po chung ngo*/ /skyabs 'gro khyad par can la phan yon sngar bshad pa ltar ma zad/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa la'ang phan yon mang du yod tshul mdo bstan bcos las gsungs pa rnams kyang shes dgos so/ /de'i phyir skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs nyams len gyi snying por byed par rigs so/ /ces pa 'di ni/ shākya'i btsun pa bshad sgrub ming can gyis gzhan la'ang phan srid snyam nas dam pa'i man ngag bzhin sbyar ba'o/ /sdig sgrib 'joms byed stobs bzhi'i nyi ma bzhugs/ /na mo shākya mu na ye/ 'dir yan lag bdun pa dang 'brel ba'i stobs bzhi'i bshags pa byed tshul 'chang ba la/ gnas khang byi dor byas nas sku gsung thugs kyi rten bgram/ mchod pa ci nus bshams te/ skyabs sems rgyud dang 'dres pa zhig sngon du btang nas/ 'jug pa bde chen 'di ltar bya ste/ bla ma mchog gsum bde gshegs mched bdun dang*/ /shāka thub la sogs rgyal ba sum cu lnga/ /sangs rgyas stong dang sems dpa' brgyad la sogs/ /skyabs gnas 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad ci rigs kyis spyan drangs nas mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i mos pa dung dung bya/

sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs dang*/ mgon po thugs rje sogs dang*/ ji snyed su dag sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa bya zhing*/ bsam shes 'di la'ang stobs bzhi don gyis tshang bar 'gyur mod/ sdig pa bshags pa'i tshe sgos su byas na legs pas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las bskyab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum sogs brjod pas sam/ gtso bo rgyal ba sogs kyis kyang de dag gi skyabs 'og tu tshud par bya/ de nas bsam pa thag pas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig / ldan na ci ma rung*/ ldan par bdag gis bya'o/ /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig /bral na ci ma rung*/ bral ba bdag gis bya'o/ / de'i ched du bdag nyid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par bya'o/ /zhes lan mang du brjod cing bsam par bya ste/ de gnyis na'ang rten ci stobs so/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis tshe rabs 'khor ba thogs pa med nas da lta la thug gi bar du nyon mongs pa'i dbang du gyur te/ mi dge ba bcu dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga dang*/ de dang nye ba lnga bgyi ba dang*/ 'phags pa la bskur ba btab pa dang*/ sems can la gnod pa'i las bgyis pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang*/ sdom pa gsum gyi bcas pa dang 'gal bas mtshon te/ bcas rang gi kha na ma tho ba'i sdig pa'i las bdag gis bgyis pa dang*/ gzhan la bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba la sogs pa mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i nyes pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad mthol lo/ /'chags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /mi sbed do/ /zhes rang gi nyes pa rnams nongs shing 'gyod pa'i yid kyis lan gsum sogs bsgrags pa ni/

rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs so/ /de ltar bu'i nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad kyang slan chad mi byed par gcod cing sdom par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyis phyin chad ci 'os su mi byed pa'i sdom sems bya ste/ slar ldog pa'i stobs so/ /bshags pa po dang bshags yul dang bshags bya la sogs pa'i chos thams cad kyang*/ rang rang gi gdags gzhi dang cha shas la brten nas rtog pas bzhag pa'i rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma dang chu'i zla ba ltar snang ba las rang bzhin gyis grub pa med do/ /zhes brjod cing*/ de'i don ci nus bsams la/ sher snying lan gsum dang bsngo smon bya'o/ /rgyas par na/ mdo sde zab mo gzhan 'dod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mtshan brjod pa dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa/ rnam rgyal/ ngan song sbyong ba'i gzung sogs bzla ba dang*/ rten bzhengs pa/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ tsha tsha gdab pa sogs gang 'grub bya bar gsungs la/ lta ba dran pa dang*/ nyes pa las ldog pa gnyis tshig gis ma brjod par bsams kyang chog mod/ skabs phyed pa'i phyir de ltar bshad do/ /ltung bshags dang sbrel nas byed na'ang*/ phyag 'tshal ba rnams ni/ yan lag bdun pa'i phyag gi skabs dang*/ bshags pa dang slar ldog gnyis rnam par sun 'byin pa sogs kyi skabs gnyis su sbyar zhing*/ bsngo ba ni/ mthar byas na legs sogs/ stobs bzhi'i dang po dang tha ma gnyis la ngos 'dzin lugs cung mi 'dra bar re yod kyang*/ sngar bshad pa'i rim pa de/ mdo nyid dang rje rin po che'i dgongs pa'o/ /de ltar stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags pa lan mang du byas na/ ngan song myong nges kyi las stobs chen yang 'dag par gsungs so/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i sgo/ /sdig ltung mun nag stugs po kun/ /stobs bzhi'i 'od stong 'bar ba'i mes/ /'joms phyir tshul 'dir 'bad pa gnad/ /ces pa 'di yang shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis gzhan la'ang phan srid snyam nas sbyar ba'o/

/na mo lo ke shwa ra ya/ tshogs gnyis bde blag tu tshogs pa'i thabs dam pa brgya rtsa'i rim pa mdor bsdus bya bar 'dod na phyag len mthong brgyud ltar shes par byas te/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs kyi skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba nas 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ lo ke shwa ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod la/ lag drug bgrang*/ mchod pa/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod pa rnams phul du byung ba'i lha rdzas phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gzung gyis byin brlabs byas la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron rnams spyan drangs/ bla ma yi dam mchog gsum sogs/ / gtor mgron 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /mchod sbyin ched du spyan 'dren gyi/ /'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhes sogs kyis phyag byas la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i sogs kyis zhal zas dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi nas/ hūṃ gis khrus bya/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ dang*/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ dang*/ oṃ dzā la me dam sarba pre ta bh+yaḥswā hā/ dang*/ oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ki te sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa ra smi bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da ya dzā la ni swā hā/ dang 'dod na/ kaṃ ka ni sogs kyi kyang chu sbyin bya/ chu'i sbyin pa 'di la brten nas klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' la sogs pa srid pa chu klung gi bdag po dang*/

gzhan bdag gnyug mar gnas pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la sbyin pa dam pa sems kyi rgyan du gyur nas don gyi mchog thob par gyur cig /de nas gtor ma rnams thun mong du/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum brjod de byin gyis brlab/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ke te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ zhes pa bdun nam gsum gyis bsngo/ mgron tshan bzhi pa yan la/ sam+bha ri mjug tu/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ sogs kyis mchod/ lnga pa man la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi tshab tu de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ dang po'i mchod pa'i mjug tu/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di/ /bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dang*/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /gnyis pa'i tshe/ bdud rtsi'i= ye shes mgon po la sogs pa/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs/ /gsum pa'i tshe/ bdud rtsi'i= drang srong chen po mchog brgyad sogs/ /bden tshig grub pa rnams la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bsam don 'grub par mdzod/ /bzhi pa'i tshe/ bdud rtsi'i= dzam+bha la sogs nor lha dang*/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i lha la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'dod rgu char bzhin phob/ /lnga pa'i tshe/ bdud= sa yi lha mo brtan ma sogs/ /yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la 'bul/ /bzhes nas stong grogs bzang po mdzod/ /drug pa'i tshe/ bdud= rta bdag brgyad sogs gnod sbyin dang*/ /lha klu sde brgyad tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bde skyid 'byung bar mdzod/ /bdun pa'i tshe/ bdud rtsi'i= 'phrog ma bu la sogs pa yi/ /gdon bgegs 'byung ba rnams la 'bul/ /bzhes nas gnod sems zhi bar mdzod/

/brgyad pa'i tshe/ bdud rtsi= skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i/ /rigs drug 'gro ba'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas sdug bsngal las grol shog /dgu ba'i tshe/ bdud rtsi= kha 'bar rgyal mos gtso byas pa'i/ /yi dwags tshogs rnams kun la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bkres skom zhi gyur cig /bcu pa'i tshe= bdud rtsi'i= thog ma med nas lan chags pa'i/ /sha khon gnyer ba rnams la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bu lon khyer gyur cig /bcu gcig pa'i tshe bdud rtsi= skal chad dbang chung gyur pa yi/ /lhag la re ba rnams la 'bul/ /bzhes nas lus sems tshim gyur cig /zhes bsngos la/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*/ zhes sogs dang*/ skar ma rab rib sogs kyi gros sbyin dang*/ bdag gi bsam pa'i sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod la/ se gol gdab cing*/ bsngo smon bya'o/ /tshig gi lo ma'i spros bral yang*/ /brgya rtsa'i don gyi snying po kun/ /ma tshang med par gcig dril ba/ /'di ko yid bzhin nor bu'o/ /ces pa 'di yang*/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i brgya rtsa bsdus pa dang mthun par shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis/ brgya rtsa gtong 'dod kyang rgyas pa ma lcogs pa 'ga' la'ang phan srid snyam nas sbyar ba'o/ /cha bzhi dang lan chags gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na/ gtor snod lnga ril bu chu gtsang bcas sta gon byas la/ skyabs sems mdor bsdus sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi par gsal bar gyur/ gtor ma rnams thun mong du a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod nas/ rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs bya ba'am/ yang na phyi ma rnams kyi tshe'ang yi ge gsum lan gsum re brjod nas byin gyis brlab/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/

bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma lha klu gzhi bdag rigs drug dang lan chags kyi mgron rnams ma lus pa gnas 'dir spyan drangs/ e h+ye hi/ ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ mgron tshan dang po gnyis so so la/ sam+bha ras lan bdun nam gsum gyis phul la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dang po'i mthar/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di ni/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang ba sogs mchog thun gyi dngos grub ma lus pa 'grub par byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ gnyis pa'i tshe/ mchod= myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po/ /dam can chos kyi rgyal po/ /'dod khams kyi dbang phyug /rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras la sogs pa chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang*/ bdag cag srung zhing skyob pa dang 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ phyi ma gsum la/ sam+bha ras bsngos nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ dang po'i mjug tu/ mchod= srid pa bar dor gnas pa dang*/ yi dgas kyi tshogs thams cad dang*/ rigs drug gi sems can rnams la'ang sbyin no/ /bzhes nas sdug bsngal mtha' dag las grol te myur du mngon par rdzogs pa 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /gnyis pa'i tshe/ mchod= lha klu sde brgyad rnams dang yul lha gzhi bdag gi tshogs thams cad la 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas bdag cag gis las dang bya ba ci byas kyang ko long dang phrag dog mi mdzad par mthun rkyen rnams yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ gsum pa'i tshe/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di ni/ thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du gzhan gyi srog bcad pa dang*/

'phrog pa dang*/ brkus pa la sogs pa'i dbang gis bu lon lan chags su gyur nas sha khon gnyer bar byed pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas lan chags bu lon mtha' dag khyer/ sha khon gnod pa thams cad zhi nas byams pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur cig /chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*/ /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsung*/ /rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos de skad gsung*/ /zhes dang*/ bdag gi bsam pa'i sogs dang*/ mgron rnams mnyes shing tshim nas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod la/ sogs gdab cing*/ bsngo smon bya'o/ /lan chags gtor ma mang du gtong bar 'dod na'ang*/ byin rlabs sngar ltar byas la/ sam+bha ras lan nyer gcig re phul ba'i mthar/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod pa sogs bya'o/ /yang na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros gdon bgegs lan chags kyi mgron rnams ma lus pa gnas 'dir spyan drangs sogs brjod la/ sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul ba sogs byas te/ mthar gshegs par bya'o/ /mchod sbyin dag pa'i zhing sa la/ /dge tshogs sa bon btab pa yi/ /nyer 'bras phan bde'i dga' ston cher/ /spyod pa'i skal bzang myong bar shog /na mo ār+ya tā ra ye/ 'byung bzhi'i gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas/ zan leb la zla gam gru gsum zlum po gru bzhi zan ril rnams dang*/ ngar glud mtheb kyu chang bu rnams ci tsam dgos pa sta gon byas la/ rang gi mdun gyi g.yon phyogs nas 'go brtsams te/ snod so so'i nang du rim par bsham pa'am/ snod gcig tu byed na zlum gtor dbus dang mdun nas g.yas skor du zla gam sogs rim bzhin dang*/ ngar mi mtheb kyu chang bu bcas logs su bzhag ste/ skyabs sems rgyas bsdus spyi ltar byas la/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba kraṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pa'i steng du rang nyid skad cig gis dam pa rgya gar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

mtshan dpes spras shing zhabs gnyis skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ mchod pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod gtor rnams lha rdzas dam pa phun sum tshogs pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis brlab/ mchod yul bskyed pa sogs ni/ chos kun rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gyur/ /stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi mkha' dbyings su/ /rin chen khri steng pad nyi zla gdan dang*/ /kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags steng dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal kun ngo bo dam pa rgya gar ni/ /mchog gsum rigs lnga yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/ /bstan srung rgya mtshos bskor nas rab bzhugs pa'i/ /gnas gsum rdo rje gsum mchan hūṃ yig las/ /'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas rang 'dra ba'i/ /ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs dbyer med gyur/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs las nyer 'khrungs shing*/ /lung rtogs yon tan du ma'i tshogs kyis brgyan/ /yid 'ong mtshan dang dpe byad dpal 'bar ba/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpag med lus sprul sgo gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul/ /sdig ltung nyes pa'i tshogs rnams so sor bshags/ /rang gzhan kun gyi dge la rjes yi rang*/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par legs bzhugs nas/ /'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /dge kun rdzob pa'i sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /rtsod med grub chen dam pa rgya gar dang*/ /mchog gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag dang sbyin bdag sogs/ /bsrung skyob mdzad cing mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /gtor ma rnams sngar ltar bsangs sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ bzhi/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'byung bzhi'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gsum gyis brlabs la/ bsngo ba ni/ dang po zla gam la dmigs te/ oṃ tsa tsha dza dzña na yaṃ o au swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis bsngos la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha sogs kyis mchod/ yaṃ las byung ba'i rlung rdzas yangs shing g.yo/ /rab sngo 'dod yon lnga ldan gtor ma 'di/ /bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam lha/ /nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*/ /khyad par rdo rje'i rigs rnams 'khor bcas la/ /'bul lo bzhes nas rnal 'byor sbyin bdag gi /rlung nad rgyal 'gong shar phyogs gdon rnams dang*/ /zhe sdang sogs zhi 'byung ba'i snyoms par mdzod/ /gnyis pa gru gsum la dmigs te/ oṃ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa raṃ e ai ṛ ṝ swā hā/ lan gsum mam bdun dang*/ sngar bzhin mchod/ raṃ las byung ba'i me rdzas tsha zhing bsreg /rab dmar 'dod yon= /bla ma= /nyan rang = khyad par rin chen rigs rnams= /'bul lo= /mkhris nad bdud btsan lho phyogs gdon rnams dang*/ /nga rgyal sogs zhi 'byung bzhi= /gsum pa zlum po la dmigs te/ /oṃ pa pha bhaṃ ma baṃ u ū swā hā/ lan gsum mam bdun dang*/ sngar bzhin mchod/ baṃ las byung ba'i chu rdzas brlan zhing gsher/ rab dkar 'dod yon= /bla ma = /nyan rang = khyad par pad+ma'i rigs rnams= /'bul lo= /grang nad dam sri nub phyogs gdon rnams dang*/ /'dod chags sogs zhi 'byung bzhi= /bzhi pa gru bzhi la dmigs te/ /oṃ ta tha da dha na laṃ l̥l̥ i ī swā hā/ lan gsum mam bdun dang*/ sngar bzhin mchod/ laṃ las byung ba'i sa rdzas sra zhing 'thas/ rab ser 'dod yon= /bla ma= /nyan rang = khyad par las kyi rigs rnams= /'bul lo= /bad kan sa bdag byang phyogs gdon rnams dang*/ /phrag dog sogs zhi 'byung bzhi snyoms par mdzod/ /lnga pa gtor ma byin brlabs spyi ltar bya ba'am/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ gnod byed gdon bgegs lan chags kyi mgron rnams ma lus pa 'dir spyan drangs/

a kā ro lan gsum gyis bsngo/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod de/ phun tshogs 'dod yon lnga ldan pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di/ /steng 'og bar gyi gdon kun dang*/ /bu lon chags pa rnams la bsngo/ /bzhes nas gnod 'tshe'i sems bor te/ /byams pa'i sems dang ldan par mdzod/ /rgyun par yin na chos sbyin dang gshegs gsol/ bsngo smon byas nas mjug bsdu ba'ang rung la/ nad pa'i ched du glud yod na legs pas/ de sngar ltar bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi ngar mi mkho dgu'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum brjod de/ a kā ros bsngo/ de nas kyai 'byung ba'i khyad par rgyas pa las/ /rus pa'i glud 'di rdo la gtong*/ sha yi glud 'di sa la= khrag gi glud 'di chu= /drod kyi glud 'di me= /dbugs kyi glud 'di rlung la= /sems kyi glud 'di mkha' la= /rdo dang sa chu me rlung dang*/ /mkha' la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di long la/ /gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor gtan bor la/ /phyin chad khon dang gnod ma byed/ /phye ltar bltas nas dri sman lnga/ /nang ltar bltas na rin chen lnga/ /gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga/ /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di long la/ khon dang gnod pa ma byed cig /chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*/ /zhes sogs kyis chos sbyin bya/ mthar se gol dang bcas te/ mgron rnams mnyes shing tshim nas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /ces brjod la/ gtor ma rnams phyogs bzhir bskyal lo/ /bsdu na snod gcig tu dbus su ngar glud 'jog pa sogs byas kyang rung bar bshad/ lo grangs yin na sngar ltar byas pa rer tshar rer brtsi zhing*/ gal te mi thub na/ gtor ma rnams re re nas lo grangs byas pa rang rang gi steng du brtsigs nas bsngo sngags tshigs bcad gnyis lo grangs dang*/

de yang ma lcogs na tshar gcig bshams te sngags lo grangs dang tshigs bcad lan cig brjod nas bsngo ba'i tshul yang bshad do/ /ji skad brjod pa de dag dam pa gzhan gyi man ngag dang*/ gtso bor paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung la brten pa yin na'ang*/ 'dir rlung dang me'i 'bul sngags kyi gsal byed de las go bzlog ste bshad pa ni sngags kyi bzlas thabs mang po las tsa sde rlung khams dang*/ ṭa sde me khams su bshad pa dang mthun par byas pa'o/ /na mo uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ye/ bsur gtong bar 'dod na/ dri bsur sta gon byas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas bsdus ci rigs sngon du btang nas/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag bzhi par gsal bar gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas/ /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog srid zhu'i mgron/ /gdon bgegs lan chags rigs drug snying rje'i mgron/ / ma lus spyan drangs 'dod pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi dri phun sum tshogs pa sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a pa lo ke te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ zhes pa bdun gyis bsngo/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ dri mchog 'dod yon lnga ldan pa'i/ /zag med bsur gyi mchod pa 'di/ /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad dang*/ /dri za'i tshogs dang rigs drug mgron/ /lha klu gzhi bdag thams cad dang*/ /lan chags sha khon gnyer ba'i gdon/ /khyad par bar do'i 'gro ba la/ /'bul lo bzhes shing tshim gyur te/

/gnas skabs bar chad kun zhi zhing*/ /tshe ring nad med 'byor pa rgyas/ /mthar yang bde ba can la sogs/ /dag pa'i zhing du skyes nas kyang*/ /'gro don ris med byed gyur cig /badz+ra muḥ mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod la bsngo smon bya'o/ /de ltar byas na phan yon mang du yod par gsungs so/ / dge'o// //na mo gu ru/ swāts+tsha gdab par 'dod na/ oṃ badz+ra kha na kha na hūṃ gis brkos pa'i sa la rin po che dang dri bzang gi phye ma bsres pa las 'jim pa gtsang ma/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung bsnan la kha yar bstan g.yas pa yang de bzhin du byas la kha bug pa'i bar du bzung ste/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jig byed ces pa nas/ yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ 'jim pa hrīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las 'jim pa rin po che'i phung por gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od dang bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa byung*/ 'jim pa la thim par byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar bsams la/ na mo bha ga wa te bai ro tsa na pra bha rā dzā la/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha ye saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ su k+ṣa me su k+ṣa me/ sa me sa me/ shān+de dan+te/ sa maṃ ro pe/ a na lam+bhe/ ta ram+bhe/ ya sho wa te/ ma hā te dze/ ni rku le/ ni ra wa te/ sarba bud dha a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭha te swā hā/ zhes pa nyer gcig gam bdun sogs bzla/ na maḥs man+ta bud dhā naṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ zhes pas 'jim pa bcad/ oṃ badz+ra ud bha wā ye swā hās 'bi 'bi bya/ oṃ a ra dzi bi ra dze swā hās snum 'byug /oṃ dharmā dhā tu gar+bhe swā hās bar du 'jug /oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra a ko ṭa ya a ko ṭa ya hūṃ gis brdung*/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba da ta/

te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ wā dī ma hā shrā ma ṇa ye swā hās me tog 'bul/ oṃ dharma ta re swā hās dbyung*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hās brtan bzhugs bya'o/ / sāts+tsha'i nang du gzungs khyad par can dbu nas nang du bsgril te bcug na las sgrib 'dag pa sogs phan yon lhag par che bar bshad pas/ de ltar byas na legs so/ /sāts+tsha la rab gnas rgyas pa ma grub na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ma ṇi sha tā dīp+ta dz+wa la dz+wa la dharma dhā tu gar+bhe swā hā/ ji srid me dang chu dang ni/ rlung gis bskal pa 'jig gi bar/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bcom ldan khyod ni bzhugs par mdzod/ /zhes lan gsum dang*/ su pra teṣ+ṭha brjod na'ang rab tu gnas pa'i go chod par bshad do/ /de lta bu'i sāts+tsha ni rten gral lam/ 'bum khang dang*/ mchod rten sogs kyi nang ngam/ gnas gtsang ma bla gab can du bzhugs pa dang*/ bzhugs pa'i gnas mi bde na chu bo chen por 'dor bar yang gsungs so/ /smras pa/ rjod byed tshig gi lo 'dab rgyas min kyang*/ /brjod bya'i 'bras bu'i khur gyis rab dud pa'i/ /gzu gnas re skong yongs 'du'i dbang 'di yang*/ /dam pa'i legs bshad dga' ba'i tshal las 'ongs/ /zhes cha bzhi/ 'byung bzhi'i gtor ma bsur gtong tshul/ sā ts+tsha gdab pa'i rim pa rnams mdor bsdus te brjod pa 'di yang*/ dam pa snga ma'i man ngag las 'byung ba'i don bzhin gzhan la phan srid snyam pa'i 'dun pas shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis mdzes byed kyi lor sbyar ba'i tshe/ dpon sras dbon chung rin po ches par shing gi gnang sbyin stsal ba la brten nas par du bsgrubs pa'o/ / maṅgalaṃ/ rus chog mdor bsdus byed na/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed nas bzhengs par gyur/ bum pa dri bzang gi chus bkang ba la dmigs te/ kaṃ ka ni dang kun rig gi gzungs ci nus bzlas la/ rus pa a mṛ tas bsangs/

rus pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar pos mtshan pa/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas dmigs yul gyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs shing dag par gyur par bsams la sngags gnyis brjod cing spel tshig dang bcas pas bkru bar bya'o/ /shu baṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/skyabs 'gro'i khrid yig mdor bsdus dang gtor ma'i rim pa gsal ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 268--PAGE 269--PAGE 256-
